Simulate an LDL cholesterol trial dataset

Source: R/simulate-ldl.R
simulate_ldl.Rd

Returns simulated, analysis-ready LDL cholesterol data modelled on a published clinical trial. Every subject is made up. The data has one row per subject per scheduled visit, with no missing values, ready for the trial's mixed model for repeated measures (MMRM).

Usage

simulate_ldl(n, study = c("orion10"))

Arguments

n

Number of subjects, randomized 1:1. When n is odd, the extra subject gets the active treatment. ORION-10 randomized 1,561.

study

The trial to model. Only "orion10" for now.

Value

A data frame with one row per subject per visit, sorted by subject and then visit, and these columns:

  • subject_id: Subject identifier, such as "001-0001".

  • treatment: Factor, "Placebo" or "Inclisiran", with placebo as the reference level.

  • age: Age in years.

  • sex: "Male" or "Female".

  • race: "White", "Black" or "Other".

  • visit: Ordered factor, "Day 150" to "Day 540".

  • day: Study day of the visit.

  • ldl_baseline: LDL at baseline, in mg/dL.

  • ldl: LDL at the visit, in mg/dL.

  • ldl_pct_change: Percent change in LDL from baseline.

Details

The only study available is ORION-10 (inclisiran vs placebo, NCT03399370). The baseline LDL, the mean percent change at each visit and the demographics follow the trial's published results. The mean percent changes follow the observed means, not the published estimates that fill in missing values, so the treatment effect is a few points larger than the published one. vignette("orion10", package = "clinique") explains each number, its source and the assumptions.

The data is simulated. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by the trial's sponsor.

References

Statistical analysis plan: https://cdn.clinicaltrials.gov/large-docs/70/NCT03399370/SAP_001.pdf

FDA statistical review: https://www.accessdata.fda.gov/drugsatfda_docs/nda/2022/214012Orig1s000StatR.pdf

Ray KK, et al. Two Phase 3 Trials of Inclisiran in Patients with Elevated LDL Cholesterol. N Engl J Med 2020;382:1507-1519. doi:10.1056/NEJMoa1912387

Examples

set.seed(1)
ldl <- simulate_ldl(100)
head(ldl)
